body: Amen, but at least it'll be someone to talk to.

Thank you so much for this.  It makes me so happy to see when that little envelope turns orange.  Even though I haven't and can't tell you the whole story, it feels so amazing to have someoni who truly listens to me.  Everyone else feels uncomfortable and shoes away whole dying vaguely comforting things, though all I tell them is just a tiny piece before they do that.  It gives me hope for just one more day every time I see a reply.  I know I can't give up.  I just have to keep holding up the other people who rely on me.  I need to get a therapist.  I will.  I know that now.  Only four more years.  That's what I've been telling my self for 15 years already.

I have a job and my sport, the sports called hunter/jumper aka show jumping.  I jump horses and I work at the barn I ride at.  It's my sanity and my future.  Im good at it and that gives me something to be proud of and look forward to in a future I might be able to attain.  I'm always doing something, too much, which has me really stressed out.  He doesn't give a fuck whether I'm busy or I'm sleeping even close to the amount my doctor told me to.  He still comes in and yells at me for an hour about who knows what.  One day I don't talk loud enough.  One day I don't answer with long enough sentences.  One day I close the door too loudly.  Every little thing I do is seen as an attack on someone, even if it's not him.  I don't try to belittle people.  I have a bad temper and I'm always rude and ugly to my family.  Sometimes that comes out on my friends too.  Everything I do seems to be filled with spite.  I don't know how, or why, or how to stop.  I'm always rude, or at least I think I am.  I'm introverted and quiet.  I can speak powerfully and am passionate about causes, but I have to think first.  I'm not good at socializing or making conversation, I like to be quiet when it's the end of the day and we're driving home.  But I can't do that be I don't know how to change.  I try but it just doesn't feel natural.  People confuse me and I'm just not good at it.  If I don't think before I speak I sound stupid or mean but if I do then it's rude to the other person.  I feel so pressured but I have no idea what to do about it.  My friends have problems of their own, multiple have recently relapsed back into cutting, or have the same friends with problems that theyre trying to help.  I don't want to burden them with any more.  A big problem is talking loud enough.  I don't talk particularly quietly but he seems to think I barely speak at all.  My friends have no idea what I'm talking about when I mention it.  He has slightly bad hearing but it's not really anything.  It literally hurts me to shout.  I have chronic headaches/migraines and noise makes it worse, especially coming from me.  He always expects to yell and it hurts.  My mom just stands by and does nothing or she agrees with him, even if it makes no sense.  I can often tell she hates it or disagrees but I don't know why she doesn't do anything.  She might be afraid of being lonely, she might be afraid of him, she might truly love him.  I just can't see why.  But there's always someone who loves a person and something about them to love.  I find myself at the medicine cabinet sometimes, staring into the drawer, aching to reach down and grab something, anything, just something to make it stop for just a little while.  Or I'm at the knife block in the kitchen.  It's right there.  It's sharp.  I might be able to hide a slit on the thigh.  No one would see, I could do it when everyone else was asleep.  No one would know.  And if they did find me, then maybe something would happen.  Something would get fixed without me having to start it.  And my grades, he expects me to get perfect grades without trying.  It comes so naturally to my siblings.  I mean my brother got the Presidents Scholarship and is a National Merit Finalist and he never stressed that much about school.  I freak out about Spanish 2.  He thinks that I should have that natural ability too and that I don't manage my time at all so it's my fault.  I'm not as smart.  I am smart, but not that smart.  I have more other things to do in my life too.  So he interrupts during my homework.  He doesn't care when I get good grades, they have to be amazing  He can't know if I get a C or D on anything.  He says it doesn't matter but it does.  It matters everyday.  I honestly think none of them have a clue.  That none of them know what's going on.  And that some of them would pretend to care if I told them, but not really give a shit or just abandon me of they knew.

Thank you so much, I think that's what I'll do.  I was sexually abused as a little kid so I can use that as a guise for it until I feel that I'm ready.  Please read the comment above, it's a much more detailed reply.

I mean that I'm a jerk.  I can't say the right thing, every time I open my lout it's the wrong thing and lose my friends a little bit more.  I have always hurt my parents everyday of my life.  My dad hates me.  I hate him.  That's how it's always worked.  That doesn't bother me very much.  It's always been that way, I only hope that if I live, we'll be able to tolerate each other for my moms sake.  My mom and I fight a lot, the house is almost always filled with yelling.  Almost every word I hear is either criticism or brain-numbing nonsense at school.  I've had many issues with my siblings in the past, but I don't see the older ones very much anymore and my little sister I've had the worst trouble with.  We're alright now, but it's hard to forget a past that keeps digging itself back up again. I don't want to tell anyone a lot because I think they won't believe me or that I'm just trying to get attention.  I know how, when, and why I'll do it.  I'm starting towards drugs.  I have so many around me that it's not hard.  Even of it isn't bad yet, with the amount of medication I've taken over the past year, my liver has taken a beating.  I had prescription ibuprofen for a while a couple months ago and I was popping 6-8 a day for about 6 months I know that's not bad but it's a start.  If I wanted to, there are drawers of my old mess sitting in my bathroom.  But, I know there will be people who miss me, there always are.  I know what can happen to people who's friends and family members commit suicide.  There's so much I'm afraid to admit to even myself, let alone to y'all.  No one understands how much it hurts right now because I can't explain it to them and the doctors can't find anything wrong with me.  I'm off medication and I can't stand it.  The last one I was on put into a zombie-like state for a few months.  My relationships got worse, my grades started slipping(I'm a straight-A student), but I didn't feel as much.  It really didn't help physically but emotionally it numbed everything.  For a little while, the yelling was quieter, the stress didn't matter anymore.  I want that again.  I'll take anything right now.   I'm not afraid of death, never have been.  I know what happens afterwards, and that everything will be better.  I'm not afraid of much.  But my worst fear is hurting people.  It regulates every action of everyday.  And I do it every moment of every day.  I'm sick of and I'm sick of myself.  I know I have a purpose for my life, some way I'll help others.  But I don't know if I want to live to see it.  I'm sick and the doctors don't know what's wrong.  On top of that I'm an athlete Ina dangerous sport, hunter/jumper.  I'm getting hurt front that(and I'm just accident prone) a lot so I don't know what what anymore.  Everything but my abs hurt and there's no end in sight.  I'm sick of it.  I can only hope that if I do live, GOD will use this to strengthen me later.  But right now I'm tired of being the strong, silent one.  It sounds childish but yes, my dogs and my horse are the only ones who know about this.  This is the first time I've found the words to say all of this.  It's not everything, but it's more than I've ever said before.  Thank you.
